source.title: Awake cortex stabilizes traveling waves for global and reliable information routing

confidence_rationale: The citation is verified exact (iScience 29(8):116728, PMID 42472099) and the paper does say what ARC-145/MECH-560 say it says -- including the supplementary result the claim notes lean on hardest, which the abstract does not mention. Held below 0.6 by species and by measure-mapping distance: this is rat cortex under isoflurane, and 'informational tuning' is a transfer-entropy-over-wave-direction construct, not RF(t)/TI(t).
failure_signatures: Overall transfer-entropy magnitude was significantly HIGHER under anaesthesia than during wakefulness (Fig. S7A), so any REE result that infers degraded routing from reduced total inter-engine transfer has the sign of the biological analogue backwards.

The paper's selectivity result is a property of directed information flow between electrode pairs, not of any behavioural competence measure; it does not by itself license MECH-560's behavioural half (that integrated behaviour degrades in proportion to lost selectivity at matched traffic).

Traveling waves are measured here only for visual-evoked responses to LED stimulation of one eye; there is no task, so 'routing state grants causal privilege' (ARC-145 property 3) is not tested against any decision.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In rat cortex, visual-evoked traveling waves are more stable when awake than under isoflurane; hierarchical clustering reveals widespread waves with a rich repertoire of motifs only in the awake state; transfer entropy is more sharply tuned to the direction of wave propagation when awake; and overall transfer-entropy magnitude is significantly higher under anaesthesia, so the awake selectivity gain cannot be attributed to greater transfer.
mapping.ree_translation: This is a biological existence proof of the dissociation shape MECH-560 asserts for REE: organisation of directed influence (selectivity, stability, motif repertoire) moving independently of -- and here in the opposite direction from -- the total amount transferred. It is motivation and a methodological template for RF(t)/TI(t), not evidence about any REE engine.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Rat sensory cortex under anaesthesia is not an REE inter-engine interface, and per feedback_lit_exp_decoupled a paper that resembles REE raises no claim's confidence. The 'informational tuning' measure must not be treated as equivalent to RF(t) or TI(t) without an explicit methodological mapping -- MECH-560's notes already require this and this entry does not supply it. Anaesthesia is also not a model of any REE failure mode.
mapping.source_context: 116-channel ultra-thin sheet ECoG covering nearly the whole right hemisphere; n = 45 sessions from 10 head-fixed rats; awake vs isoflurane-anaesthetised; LED flash to the left eye; transfer entropy normalised by pairwise mutual information.

confidence_components.notes: Novel high-density preparation and a clean pre-registered-looking contrast, single lab, no replication. Mapping fidelity is the binding constraint for MECH-561 (the paper says nothing about phase as an addressing coordinate for a communication subspace) and is more generous for MECH-560.
